MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 38
   C. 19
   D. 60

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 2/2
   D. They are equal

3. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 64
   C. 16
   D. 65

4. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31.7
   D. 31

5. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

6. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

7. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 29
   C. 23.7
   D. 23

8. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

9. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

10. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 42

11. Solve for x: x + 4 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 5
   C. 9
   D. 4

12. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 15
   C. 30
   D. 44

14. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 13
   C. 7
   D. 15

15. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 7

16. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 13
   C. 40
   D. 3

17. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 22

18. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.025
   D. 0.25

19. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 37
   D. 1

20. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 2

21. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 10

22. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 2/3
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/4

23. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 21
   C. 15.6
   D. 15.7

24. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.7
   C. 33
   D. 27.6

25. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 81

26. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 8
   C. 17
   D. 0

27. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

28. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 169

29. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 100
   B. 11
   C. 50
   D. 10

30. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 11

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
